decisions.reason: Although this UV spot varnishing system is farther from the core range, its flagship role in the firm's move into print enhancement means the learning value still outweighs the likely low portfolio-carrying cost of keeping it for another year.
The sheet preparation module fits directly into existing postpress workflows and is inexpensive to retain as an option while demand continues to reveal itself.
The B2-format multifinisher is both close to the established business and strategically emphasized, so real-options logic strongly favors continued commitment rather than early abandonment.

The hybrid saddle stitcher remains within the firm's familiar booklet-making and binding space, and without a clear negative signal it is worth keeping despite somewhat more uncertainty than the flagship systems.
As a complementary folding add-on with at least one visible reference application, it is a relatively cheap option to keep open while broader market uptake becomes clearer.
